title: Private human claim-review CLI and append-only audit history v0
problem: Blocked by ticket-418. The new needs-review state requires an operator surface that shows sufficient source context and records explicit decisions without exposing private source text or adding public write routes.
acceptance_criteria: A private operator CLI lists needs-review claims with source metadata, section, quote, bounded context, structured fields, validator reasons, and prior decisions.
Accept and reject operations require explicit claim ID, decision reason, reviewer identifier or local operator label, and confirmation; batch accept is not supported in v0.
Review writes use the lifecycle transition API and append-only audit history; reruns cannot silently overwrite a prior decision.
The CLI refuses public databases or public-output paths and emits no raw prompt or secret values.
No HTTP route, public-site action, or public review payload is added.
Unit tests prove unauthorized transitions, stale-version decisions, and invalid claim IDs fail closed.
On completion, ticket-420 changes from blocked to ready; no later Phase 4 ticket is activated.
test_plan: With mock-only env: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_claim_review_cli.py tests/unit/test_claim_admission_lifecycle.py tests/unit/test_claim_graph_consumer_isolation.py -q
With mock-only env: python -m pytest tests/golden -q
With mock-only env: python -m rge.cli verify --skip-site
non_goals: Do not build a web review UI.
Do not permit automatic or bulk human-review acceptance.
Do not publish quotes, context, reviewer labels, or decision notes.
Do not merge duplicate claims in this ticket.
rollback_plan: Remove the CLI command while retaining lifecycle and review history tables. Existing needs-review candidates remain quarantined and no records are deleted.
